senses.gloss: , נָוֵל (cmp. נָבֵל) to be disfigured, look repulsive; to degenerate.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 14:7">Tosef. Sot. XIV, 7</cite> <he>אזלה ונָוְלָה</he> (Var. <he>ונָבְלָה</he>) becomes more and more corrupt.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 154a:8-11">B. Bath. 154ᵃ</cite> <he>אי … לנַוְּולוֹ</he> you are not permitted to disgrace him (to search a corpse for tokens of maturity).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 1:6">Sot. I, 6</cite> <he>מעבירים ממנה כדי לנַוְּולָהּ</he> we divest her (of all jewelry) in order to disgrace her.
<cite ref="Nedarim 66a:14">Ned. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>בנות ישראל</he> … <he>שהעניות מְנַוַּולְתָּן</he> Israel’s daughters are handsome, it is only poverty that makes them appear homely.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 240:3">Sifré Deut. 240</cite> (ref. to <he>נבלה</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 22:21">Deut. XXII, 21</cite>) <he>לא עצמה בלבד נִוְּולָה וכ׳</he> she has disgraced not only herself but all virgins of Israel; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְנוּוָּל</he>; f. <he>מְנוּוֶּלֶת</he>; pl. <cite ref="M01737"><he>מְנוּוָּלִין</he></cite>, <he>מְנוּוָּלוֹת</he>. Y. Pes. VI, 33ᵃ, sq. <he>זבח מ׳</he> (not <cite ref="M00708"><he>מזבח</he></cite>) a repulsive (putrid) sacrifice (<cite ref="Shabbat 116b:7">Sabb. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>מוטלין כנבלה</he>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 4:5">Naz. IV, 5</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="A02841"><he>אֶפֶשׁ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 2:3">Tosef. Sot. II, 3</cite> <he>הרי היא בדוקה ומנ׳</he> she (by refusing to drink the searching waters) is already searched and disgraced, i.e. has admitted her guilt. Y. M. Kat. III, beg. 81ᶜ. <he>שלא … מנ׳</he> that they may not enter the Sabbath with neglected hair; a. e.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 30b:8">Kidd. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>אם פגע בך מנ׳ זה וכ׳</he> if that ugly one (the tempter) meets thee, drag him to the house of learning, i.e. overcome evil inclinations by study.
